استجهلا (form X)

# اُسْتُجْهِلَا (ustujhilā) /us.tud͡ʒ.hi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# اِسْتَجْهِلَا (istajhilā) /is.tad͡ʒ.hi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
